params.body:
Three small screen fixes, one PR.

## Mijn aangeboden wagens (`/exports`)

At 1440 the page head was a title, a full-width sentence, a lone button "Zoek gemiddelde verkoopprijs handelaars", 60px of air, and then Sorteer op / Filteren far right. Now:

- the sentence is a quiet lead under the title (`ui-page-lead`, max 70ch);
- the average-price button sits on the same `ui-list-toolbar` row as Sorteer op and Filteren (button left, sort and filter right); on a phone it takes the full row and sort/filter share the row under it (`ui-toolbar-action`);
- the button and its modal moved to `export/_average_price.blade.php`; the bidding detail keeps it in its page head as before.

The bid form (`export/form.blade.php`) already is a two-column `ui-form-grid` inside a modal, so nothing to compact there.

## Delete icon was an empty white square (Nieuw in Stocklist en Hulpvideo's)

The `fa-trash` glyph was present; its colour was white on a white button. Two causes on the `<a>` itself, and the icon inherited whatever landed there: `text-white` copied from the filled Bootstrap button (Tailwind loads last, so it won over the red variant), and, once that was gone, Bootstrap's `a:not([href]):not([tabindex]) { color: inherit }` on an `<a onclick>` without href, which beats one class on specificity.

Root fix in `refresh.css`: the icon takes its colour from `--ui-action-ink`, which every `ui-action-button` variant sets next to `color`. Nothing that lands on the anchor's own `color` reaches the glyph any more. `text-white` is dropped on the release-notes list and on the copy/edit buttons of the exports list (same square, visible in the phone cards). `settings/role/index.blade.php` carries the same class and is fixed by the token alone; the file is left to the settings agent.

## Damage card on the stocklist detail

A damage with photos but no note showed "Geen opmerking" above the photos; when the files were missing (every tile removes itself on `onerror`) an empty card was left. Now: no note line when there are photos; when the last tile fails, one quiet line "Foto's niet beschikbaar" (`vehicle.photos_unavailable`, nl/fr/en/de). `partNumber()` numbering unchanged.

## Tests

- `ReleaseNotesDeleteIconTest`: the delete control is a danger action button with a trash glyph and no `text-white`; every action-button rule that sets `color` sets `--ui-action-ink`.
- `StocklistDamageCardTest`: photos without a note (tiles, hidden fallback, no "geen opmerking", 1-based number); note with photos.
- Ran `Export|Bidding|ReleaseNote|Damage|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity` (76 tests, 1037 assertions, OK) plus `ListPageHeaders|AveragePriceSearch|SettingsPhoneLayout` (26 tests, OK).

Findings: `2026-09-15-verwijderknop-leeg-vierkant-actieknop-icoon.md`, `2026-09-15-schadekaart-zonder-opmerking-met-fotos.md` (both opgelost).
params.title: Exports page compact, delete icon visible, damage card honest about photos
